title: .omne/skill.json
description: The declarations of a Skill package, format version 1. The behavior owner is SPEC.md of @omne-harness/skill-contract. This schema does not express these rules: the JSON budget, that a script entry is a file of the package and not a control file, that script entries are unique after . segments are removed, and that setting names are unique.

formatVersion.description: Only the number 1, written as 1. Any other value is declaration-format-unsupported.

dependencies.description: Required tools. An absent list is an empty list.

scripts.description: Script declarations. An absent list is an empty list.

entry.description: A relative path inside the package. No leading slash, no backslash, no empty segment, no .. segment, no control character.

runKind.description: Skill does not interpret the run kind.

facilities.description: Facility names. Skill does not check whether a facility is present.

parameters.description: The parameter shape. Any JSON value, kept as it was read.

settings.description: Setting declarations: names and categories, never values. An absent list is an empty list.
